title: ৎ, ঐ, ৈ, ঔ and ৌ
body:
# Lesson 14: ৎ, ঐ, ৈ, ঔ and ৌ

The last vowels (oi, ou) and ৎ (khondo to), a t with no vowel after it. After this you can read almost any everyday word letter by letter.

| Script | Sound | Note |
|---|---|---|
| ৎ | khondo to: t | Looks like a ত with a hook; never has a vowel after it. |
| ঐ | oi (vowel letter) | এ with an extra curl on top. ঐ (that) is also spelt ওই. |
| ◌ৈ | oi-kar: oi | ে with an extra loop; sits in front of the letter. |
| ঔ | ou (vowel letter) | ও with a tail on top. Rare. |
| ◌ৌ | ou-kar: ou | Like ো but the right side has a tail. Look closely. |

## How they combine

ৈ goes BEFORE the consonant like ে: ত + ৈ = তৈ **toi**. ৌ wraps around like ো: ন + ৌ = নৌ **nou**. ৎ only ends a syllable: হঠাৎ **hothat**.

## Read these

Cover the right side, read the script aloud, then check.

- হঠাৎ → hothat: suddenly
- ভবিষ্যৎ → bhobishshot: future
- সৎ → shot: honest
- তৈরি → toiri: ready, made
- নৌকা → nouka: boat
- ঔষধ → oushodh: medicine

cards.Meaning: a final t with no vowel
cards.Notes: Looks like a ত with a hook; never has a vowel after it.
এ with an extra curl on top. ঐ (that) is also spelt ওই.

cards.Meaning: vowel sign oi, written BEFORE the consonant
cards.Notes: ে with an extra loop; sits in front of the letter.
ও with a tail on top. Rare.

cards.Meaning: vowel sign ou, written around the consonant
cards.Notes: Like ো but the right side has a tail. Look closely.

cards.Example: হঠাৎ বৃষ্টি hothat brishti: sudden rain
cards.Notes: হ h + ঠ th + া aa + ৎ t.
ভ bh + ব b + ি i + ষ্য shsh (য-ফলা doubles ষ) + ৎ t.

cards.Example: উনি সৎ uni shot: he / she is honest
চা তৈরি cha toiri: the tea's ready
cards.Notes: ত t + ৈ oi + র r + ি i.

cards.Example: একটা নৌকা ekta nouka: a boat
cards.Notes: ন n + ৌ ou + ক k + া aa.

cards.Example: ঔষধ খাও oushodh khao: take your medicine
cards.Notes: ঔ ou + ষ sh + ধ dh. Everyday word is ওষুধ oshudh.
